instruction: Fix `rotate` in `seqops/transforms.py` so negative rotation counts rotate to the left. It currently takes the absolute value of `k`, so `rotate(items, -1)` rotates right by one instead of left by one.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/transforms.py b/seqops/transforms.py
--- a/seqops/transforms.py
+++ b/seqops/transforms.py
@@ -23,7 +23,7 @@
     n = len(items)
     if n == 0:
         return []
-    k = abs(k) % n
+    k %= n
     return items[-k:] + items[:-k]
